Concept.Mapping.Status: candidate exposure mapping; official questionnaire/codebook field identified; route, denominator and derivation review required
Concept.Mapping.Caveat: Single-wave candidate based on prior-day wake and bedtime questions. The 2013 questionnaire prints separate AM and PM response rows for each 12-hour clock item; the Codebook's paired time components map _1/_2 to the AM row and _3/_4 to the PM row. Preserve raw components and verify released-file storage/routing before constructing a clock time. Do not interpret the sparse PM wake row as a separate construct or use Codebook frequencies as project sample-size estimates. WB05-WB15 are asked in the same yesterday-recall block, so associations with those mood items have no established temporal direction. This is not usual sleep timing, sleep duration, or a multi-day average.

Variable.Name: qg003

Use.Constraints: CHARLS applicant data; access and publication governed by official agreement
subcategory: strength, mobility, lung function, and performance
Candidate.Status: official questionnaire/Codebook timed-walk candidate; release eligibility and analytic derivation remain pending
Harmonization.Status: Official instrument defines two usual-pace timed walks over a 2.5-metre course; each raw trial is recorded in seconds. Age 60+ and walking-safety/site eligibility gates apply. Preserve qg002/qg003 as trial components of one phenotype; questionnaire-defined 993 (tried but unable) and 999 (chose not to do it) are status codes, not elapsed seconds. Do not convert them to time, treat routed absence as zero, derive speed, or average trials until the authorized release, valid values, measurement eligibility and a prespecified derivation are verified. Cross-wave harmonization is not approved.
Review.Flag: phenotype candidate; preserve first/second trial identity and status codes; do not treat trials as independent concepts or derive a speed/summary without prespecified rules and authorized-release validation
Value.Label.Review: continuous timed measurement; seconds and non-completion status codes reviewed from official instruments; no categorical response labels or Codebook summaries copied
Concept.Label.Candidates: 计时步行表现（2.5米，两次计时）
Concept.Mapping.Status: 2015官方问卷/手册与Codebook已逐项核对：2.5米通常步速路线、两次计时、秒单位、60岁及以上年龄筛选及步行安全/场地路线已记录；这是候选表型字段审查，不含参与者记录、频数或有效值分布。
Concept.Mapping.Caveat: qg002/qg003保留为两次独立原始计时但属于同一候选表型；993=尝试但无法完成、999=选择不做，须作为状态码保留而非秒数。这些状态码不是 elapsed seconds (not elapsed seconds)。不得把结构性未测记为0；从2.5米和计时推导速度或汇总两次试验前，需核验授权发布文件、特殊值、测量资格和预设算法。跨波协议相似不自动证明样本、设备、路由、存储和数值范围可直接合并。
